title: Renaming .gdshader files leads to application shutdown
body:
### Tested versions

- Version Present in: 
[himansh@archlinux Desktop]$ godot --version
4.6.1.stable.arch_linux.14d19694e


### System information

Operating System: Arch Linux  KDE Plasma Version: 6.6.2 KDE Frameworks Version: 6.23.0 Qt Version: 6.10.2 Kernel Version: 6.19.8-arch1-1 (64-bit) Graphics Platform: Wayland Processors: 4 × Intel® Core™ i7-6600U CPU @ 2.60GHz Memory: 8 GiB of RAM (7.6 GiB usable) Graphics Processor 1: Intel® HD Graphics 520 Graphics Processor 2: AMD Radeon R7 M360 Manufacturer: Dell Inc. Product Name: Latitude E5470

### Issue description

Whenever I rename a .gdshader file for a texture rect linked to a png, the application switches off and I have to restart it. The changes of renaming are applied when I restart the project. The only problem is the unexpected exit from the program.
It seems to happen in specific cases only, I can't figure out which but, it keeps happening in the file listed below.
